notable_absence.finding: This is the only page in the directory whose response is not the query response envelope. Every other example returns requestID + status + metrics (+ errors); this one returns a single line, "HTTP/1.1 405 Method Not Allowed", with no body at all - no requestID, no error code, no metrics. That means a method-level rejection is not correlatable in system:completed_requests and produces nothing for the error-code reference to describe, because it is refused before a request is admitted. The page states none of this; it is a two-line page with no prose beyond "For a REST method type that is not supported". It also does not enumerate which methods ARE supported on /query/service - intro.md does (GET and POST only) - nor mention whether an Allow header is returned, which is what a client would use. Recorded here rather than padded out: the observation belongs to the directory-wide error model on intro.json.

version_finding: None. No version or edition marker, and no statement of when method restrictions changed. Note that intro.md documents DELETE on several /admin/* endpoints and POST on /admin/settings, so the 405 here is specific to /query/service rather than a property of the Query Service's ports.
